comparison.objective: Lay two ordered cables into a carrier and snap all twelve crossbars shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable routing, order preservation, repeated hinge closure, and snap-latching.
comparison.success_condition: Both cables correctly routed without crossing; every crossbar latched; strain relief intact; system released.
comparison.reason: Repeated snap-latching over deformable cables is different from striking a mandrel to fracture notched rigid tangs and collecting the fragments.
